# tailor_telemetryrouter_otlp_exporter (Resource)

The telemetryrouter_otlp_exporter resource configures an OTLP destination to which a workspace's
OpenTelemetry signals (traces, metrics, and logs) are forwarded. A workspace may have multiple
exporters, each identified by a unique name.

This resource was previously named `tailor_telemetryrouter_telemetry_export`. To migrate an
existing resource without destroying it, rename the resource type in your configuration and add
a `moved` block (Terraform >= 1.8):

```terraform
moved {
  from = tailor_telemetryrouter_telemetry_export.example
  to   = tailor_telemetryrouter_otlp_exporter.example
}
```

Do not rename the resource type without a `moved` block — Terraform would otherwise plan to
destroy and recreate the exporter. If `moved` is unavailable, remove the old entry with
`terraform state rm` and re-import it under the new type instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tailor_telemetryrouter_otlp_exporter" "datadog" {
  workspace_id = tailor_workspace.example.id

  name     = "datadog"
  endpoint = "otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
  protocol = "grpc"

  auth = {
    api_key = {
      header_name = "dd-api-key"
      secret_value = {
        vault_name  = tailor_secretmanager_vault.example.name
        secret_name = "datadog-api-key"
      }
    }
  }

  enable_traces = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The OTLP endpoint to forward signals to. The connection must use TLS; plain "http://" is not supported. For the "http" protocol, give an https base URL such as "https://otlp.example.com" — the OTLP signal path (/v1/traces, /v1/metrics, /v1/logs) is appended automatically per enabled signal, so do not include it. For the "grpc" protocol, use "host:port" (e.g. "otlp.example.com:4317") or "https://host[:port]" (the port defaults to 443 when omitted).
- `name` (String) The unique name of this exporter within the workspace. Must match the pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$.
- `protocol` (String) The OTLP transport protocol. One of "grpc" or "http".
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace this OTLP exporter belongs to.

### Optional

- `auth` (Attributes) Optional authentication for the endpoint. Exactly one of api_key or bearer_token may be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `enable_logs` (Boolean) Whether to forward log signals to this exporter. Defaults to false.
- `enable_metrics` (Boolean) Whether to forward metric signals to this exporter. Defaults to false.
- `enable_traces` (Boolean) Whether to forward trace signals to this exporter. Defaults to false.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this exporter is active. Defaults to true.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional headers to attach to outgoing requests to the endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Optional:

- `api_key` (Attributes) API-key authentication. The secret value is sent in the configured header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--api_key))
- `bearer_token` (Attributes) Bearer-token authentication. The secret value is sent as an Authorization bearer token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--bearer_token))

<a id="nestedatt--auth--api_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.api_key`

Required:

- `header_name` (String) The name of the header that carries the API key (e.g. "x-api-key").
- `secret_value` (Attributes) Reference to the secret holding the API key value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--api_key--secret_value))

<a id="nestedatt--auth--api_key--secret_value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.api_key.secret_value`

Required:

- `secret_name` (String) The key of the secret within the vault.
- `vault_name` (String) The name of the vault that stores the secret.
